page.layout: One page of text in a single column. No margin notes. Running head at top centre, page number at top left. Catchword at bottom right.

head.i: Ista sunt peculiaria corpori humano toti.

main_text.p: Quæ in membris corporis humani peculiaria observantur, (ut quòd omnia sint elegantiora, & perfectiora in iis, quàm in bestiis; quòd loco anteriorum pedū brachia teneant, & similia) cùm non alia membra genere diversa constituant; ex quotidiana inspectione & anatomica industria deprehenduntur.

p.i: Sic igitur de anima & corpore, essentialibus hominis partibus, seorsim breviter dixisse suf-ficiat: totius nunc hominis peculiaris quoq; progressio & generatio con-sideranda.

main_text.p: Progressio hominis est incessus ordinatissimus corporis erecti super duobus pedibus, totum hominem de loco in locum transferens.
Generatio vero est, quâ totus homo ex femine parentum nascitur.

Partes quidem corporis organicæ conforma-tur primò omnes ex subjecto femine, usq; ad diem à conceptione circiter 40: in embryone dein jam membrorum omnium dispositionem habente, anima vi feminis prolifici plastica ex-citatur, atq; ita ex corpore & anima rationali u-nitis unus homo subsistens progeneratur.
unde etiam tum temporis fœtus in utero ma-terno primùm vivere & sentire incipit.

page.notes: Printed hyphens kept at line ends: "ex-", "u-", "conforma-", "ma-", "suf-", "con-", "Nu-". Doubtful readings: "quoq;" is read as the abbreviation for quoque. The last word of the italic sentence reads as "consideranda." in the scan, possibly "considerandæ". Stray marks on the right edge near "ex-" and "u-" are not printed text. Long s has been read as s throughout.
